name: What is the process for getting a flooring installation estimate for a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a flooring installation estimate for a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get a flooring installation estimate, start by contacting a general contractor like City Dweller, LLC. We typically begin with an initial consultation, either remotely or on-site, to discuss your project goals, preferred flooring types, and budget. Next, an on-site visit is scheduled to accurately measure the spaces, assess the subfloor condition, and identify any potential challenges like existing flooring removal or repairs. Following this, a detailed, itemized quote will be provided, outlining material costs, labor, and any additional services.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial consultation, an on-site measurement and subfloor assessment, followed by a detailed, itemized quote.
